description: Give a character a skeleton and skin weights, as a GLB ready to pose and animate (tripo-rig 45, meshy-rig 35, rodin-rig 35 credits); then animate_model makes it move. Humanoids with every model: tripo-rig (default) takes bone_names (mixamo, unity, unreal, vrm) so an engine's own animations play on it; rodin-rig is the fastest, about 30 s; meshy-rig adds an FBX. Four-legged animals with rodin-rig only: body horse, dog or cow, and the rig comes with that animal's walk and run (walk_glb, run_glb). Best on one closed model standing in a T-pose or A-pose (an animal on all fours, facing +Z); remesh a generated model first, never after. The mesh is a URL, an upload id, a library id or a job id. Waits about 45 s, then returns job_id for get_job.

body.description: rodin-rig only: humanoid, or a four-legged animal (horse, dog, cow).

mesh.description: The model: URL, upl_..., library id, or job_...
